preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 100,000, inclusive.
The number of roads m is between 1 and 100,000, inclusive.
Each road connects two distinct cities with numbers between 1 and n, inclusive.
No road connects a city to itself.

preconditions.expression: No more than one road between each pair of cities
preconditions.description: Each pair of cities is connected by no more than one road.

postconditions.description: The output is the minimum number of separate cities after the reform.
